0022600006.text: The 76ers (1-0, on a W1 streak) take on the Cavaliers at home in their second game of the season, sitting first in the Atlantic and second in the East after a road win. Cleveland has not played a 2026-27 game yet, and the teams have no meetings this season so far. Philadelphia lost all four matchups with Cleveland in 2025-26, most recently 115-101 in Cleveland on March 9, 2026. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, ruptured), Dominick Barlow (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps), and Dean Wade is day-to-day with an ankle sprain. Cleveland is without Khalifa Diop (knee) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back), and Jarrett Allen is day-to-day with a knee issue.
